findings.title: Published stash CLI fails at startup for every command because @cipherstash/auth does not load
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Nothing shows that @cipherstash/auth's default-import interop actually fails. The startup crash is conjecture about an unspecified platform or packaging.

findings.title: stash init cannot complete without interactive network login and device binding
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Same confirmed mechanism as F-04: an unconditional auth step plus unhandled errors and process.exit(1) block init.

findings.title: New docs and init next steps say no env vars are needed, but stash secrets and LockContext still require CS_* credentials
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Confirmed: the README and next-steps now say no credentials are needed, but secrets getConfig and loadWorkSpaceId still require CS_* or TOML.

findings.title: Downgraded and exact-pinned runtime dependencies change library behaviour for consumers
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The downgrades and exact pins of evlog and @byteslice/result are confirmed in package.json and the lockfile diff.
